in_sanskrit.name: ईशान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ईशान (Ishan) is a Sanskrit name that means 'Lord', 'God', or 'Ruler'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Ish', which means 'to rule' or 'to possess'. In Hinduism, Ishan is often associated with Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation, who is also known as the Lord of the Universe.

in_hindi.name: ईशान
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईशान (Ishan) is also the Hindi transcription of the Sanskrit name 'ईशान'. In Hindi, it is pronounced as 'ईशान' and it means 'ईश्वर (Ishwar)', which is a common name for God or the Supreme Being in Hinduism.

in_tamil.name: ஈஷன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஈஷன் (Ishan) is the Tamil transcription of the Sanskrit name 'ईशान'. In Tamil, it is pronounced as 'ஈஷன்' and it means 'இழவர் (Izhvan)', which means 'God' or 'Lord' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: ైశ్ణ్

in_marathi.name: Ishan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God, Lord, Ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘ish’, meaning god or lord. It is believed to be a form of Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and creation. Ishan is also considered the ruler of the universe and the guardian of Dharma. In Hindu mythology, Ishan is depicted as having a third eye, representing wisdom and inner vision.
